app.name: AgriVision
app.tagline: Smarter farm decisions for Jordan, built on NASA data

notif.off: Notifications are off. Turn them on in Settings.

landing.heroTitle: Know what to grow, where, and when
landing.heroBody: AgriVision turns NASA satellite data into clear planting guidance for your farm in Jordan, and explains the reason behind every recommendation.
landing.step1Body: We find you on a satellite map, or you search for your area or type its coordinates.
landing.step2Body: Drag on the map to draw a rectangle over each parcel and adjust its corners, or enter coordinates. Area and perimeter are calculated automatically.
landing.step3Body: We assess crop suitability, planting time, rotation, and risks.
landing.powerBody: 10+ years of daily temperature, rainfall, solar radiation, and humidity.
landing.smapBody: Surface soil moisture from the SMAP satellite at about 9 km resolution.
landing.gpmBody: Rainfall estimates from the Global Precipitation Measurement mission at 0.1°.
landing.jordanBody: Covers all 12 governorates, focuses on 13 crops common in Jordan from wheat and barley to olives and date palms, and measures land in dunums.
landing.footer: A NASA Space Apps "Field Shift" project. Recommendations are guidance and do not replace a local agricultural engineer.
landing.builtWith: Built with NASA POWER, SMAP and GPM IMERG

auth.signInBody: Sign in to continue with your farm.
auth.registerBody: Two minutes and you can start analyzing your land.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send reset instructions.
auth.forgotSent: If this email is registered, you'll receive a message with reset instructions.
auth.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.panelQuote: Data from space, for decisions on the ground.

locate.title: Where is your land?
locate.body: We use your location to show your land on the map. We never share it.
locate.denied: We couldn't detect your location automatically
locate.deniedBody: Search for your governorate or area, type your land's coordinates, or click the map.
locate.outsideBody: AgriVision currently supports farms inside Jordan only. Search for your land or click the map.
locate.clickMap: or click the map to set the location
locate.moveHint: Drag the pin or click the map to change the location.
locate.approxBody: This is a city-level estimate from your internet connection and may be kilometres from your land. Drag the pin, click the map or search to set the exact place.
locate.approxToast: Exact location unavailable; moved to an approximate location from your internet connection.
locate.deniedToast: Couldn't detect your location. Allow location access for this site in the browser settings, or search manually.
locate.chooseManually: I'd rather set the location myself

reasons.denied: Reason: location permission is blocked for this site in the browser. Click the padlock next to the address, allow "Location", then try again.
reasons.insecure: Reason: browsers only allow location on a secure connection (https) or on localhost.
reasons.unsupported: Reason: this browser doesn't support location detection.
reasons.unavailable: Reason: the device returned no position. Check that Location services are on in the system settings (Windows: Settings → Privacy & security → Location).

locate.approxDevice: Approximate location: may be up to {{m}} m from where you are
locate.approxDeviceBody: This device did not give a precise position (no GPS, or you are indoors). The circle on the map shows where you may be. Drag the pin onto your land, or open the site on your phone while standing in the farm to get its exact position.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's a quick look at your farm today.

farm.title: My Farm
farm.selectPlot: Select a plot on the map to see its details.
farm.noFarmBody: Add your first farm to get started.
farm.layerNote: Environmental layers are uniform across the farm because the satellite cell is larger than the farm.

analysis.title: New Analysis

objectivesBody.crop_suitability: How suitable a crop you choose is for your plot.
objectivesBody.crop_recommendation: Rank the crops that fit your land best.
objectivesBody.planting_window: A planting calendar with the best periods.
objectivesBody.rotation: Compare your current rotation with two options.
objectivesBody.water: How much irrigation water you need each month.

analysis.plantingDateHint: Leave empty and we'll suggest the best date.
analysis.processingBody: This can take a minute the first time data is fetched.
analysis.failed: The analysis could not be completed
analysis.cropOptional: Optional: leave it on "Current crops" to analyse each parcel's own crop.
analysis.reviewNote: We'll analyse the climate record for your farm's location, then prepare the results. This can take a minute the first time.
analysis.failedOffline: Climate data could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
analysis.failedInterrupted: The analysis stopped because the page was closed or reloaded before it finished. Run it again.
analysis.cropOptionalAll: Optional: leave it on "All crops" to see the best planting period for every crop, best first.

results.climatology: Based on historical climate data, not a weather forecast.
results.sharedCell: Climate readings are the same for all parcels of the farm because they are close together. Differences between parcels come from their own details: crop, irrigation and soil.
results.disclaimer: The score estimates environmental suitability and does not guarantee yield. Consult a local agricultural engineer before deciding.
results.engineFallback: The machine-learning model could not be loaded, so the rule-based engine was used.

rotation.title: Crop Rotation
rotation.review: Risks to review with a local agricultural engineer
rotation.applied: The next crop was applied to the plot.
rotation.empty: Pick a plot and a priority, then press "Compare strategies".

analytics.title: Environmental Analytics
analytics.soilNote: Soil moisture here is an estimated root-zone index, as a share of full saturation.

risks.title: Risk Center
risks.none: No high risks at the moment.
risks.empty: No risk assessment has been run for this farm yet.

reports.title: Reports

settings.title: Settings
settings.dunumHint: A dunum in Jordan is 1000 m². Change it if your region uses a different dunum.
settings.dunumInvalid: Enter a value between 100 and 10000 m².
settings.tileUrlInvalid: The URL must start with https and contain {z}, {x} and {y}.
settings.deleteFarmBody: Farm "{{name}}" and all its parcels, history and analyses will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

states.errorBody: We couldn't load the data. Please try again.
states.offline: You're offline. Showing the last saved data.
states.missingData: Some data is unavailable for this location or period.
states.unsupportedLocationBody: This location is outside Jordan. AgriVision supports farms in Jordan only.
states.unsupportedCropBody: This crop is not among the 13 supported crops.
states.validation: Please check the data you entered.
states.serverDownBody: Check your internet connection and try again.
states.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

parcels.title: Parcel management
parcels.drawOnMapBody: Press and drag on the map to draw a rectangle or square over your land, then adjust the corners to match its shape.
parcels.enterCoordsBody: Type the boundary points manually: latitude then longitude for each point.
parcels.chooseMethod: How do you want to set the boundary?
parcels.drawHelp: Click the map to add polygon vertices. Click the first point (or double-click) to close the shape.
parcels.reshapeHelp: Drag any corner to change the shape. Click the small point on an edge to add a corner; right-click a corner to remove it. The centre handle moves the whole parcel and the top handle rotates it. Area and perimeter update automatically.
parcels.coordsHelp: One point per line as: latitude, longitude (decimal degrees). Example: 32.5568, 35.8469. The boundary appears on the map as you type.
parcels.coordsHint: The boundary appears here as you type; you can drag vertices
parcels.closeHint: Click the first point to close the shape
parcels.reshapeHint: Drag corners to reshape, the centre to move, the top handle to rotate
parcels.dunumNote: Dunum in use = {{m2}} m² (change it in Settings).
parcels.name: Parcel name
parcels.deleteBody: Parcel "{{name}}" (no. {{number}}, {{area}}) and its crop history will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
parcels.emptyBody: Add your first parcel by drawing it on the map or entering its coordinates.
parcels.importInvalid: The file is not valid GeoJSON.
parcels.boundarySaved: Boundary saved; area and perimeter updated.
parcels.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the data and try again.
parcels.saveFailedStorage: Could not save: browser storage is full or blocked. Your changes were not saved.
parcels.duplicateNumber: This number is already used by another parcel in the farm.

issues.too_few_points: A polygon needs at least 3 different vertices.
issues.out_of_range: Latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
issues.duplicate_points: There is a repeated point. Remove the duplicate vertex.
issues.self_intersecting: The boundary crosses itself. Move the vertices so the edges do not cross.
issues.too_small: The area is too small (under 10 m²). Check the vertex positions.
issues.outside_jordan: Part of the parcel is outside Jordan. Only land inside Jordan is supported.
issues.overlaps_parcel: The boundary overlaps parcel {{label}}. Move it so the two parcels do not overlap (a shared border is fine).

lineError.format: Line {{line}}: type two numbers as "lat, lon"

toolHelp.rect: Press on the map, drag over your land and release: a rectangle covers the marked area. Handles then appear so you can reshape it.
toolHelp.square: Press, drag and release to draw a square with equal sides (in metres). Handles then appear so you can reshape it.
toolHelp.points: For irregular land: click to add corners one by one, then click the first point or double-click to close.
toolHelp.pan: Move and zoom the map until you reach your land, then pick a drawing tool.

toolHint.rect: Press and drag to mark the parcel area
toolHint.square: Press and drag to draw a square
toolHint.pan: Move the map, then pick a drawing tool

parcels.dragTooSmall: Press and drag a longer distance to mark the area.
parcels.moveShape: Drag to move the whole parcel
parcels.labNote: If you have a laboratory test of this parcel's soil, enter what you know from it. It is saved with the parcel and used by the forecast, the rotation planner and the analyses instead of the automatic estimate.

guest.title: What should I grow on my land?
guest.body: Set your land's location and we'll suggest the crops that suit it best. No account needed.
guest.water: Is irrigation available on your land?
guest.loadingBody: This can take a few seconds the first time.
guest.saveCta: Create an account to save your land, its parcels and your analysis history, and get an analysis for each parcel.
guest.noCrops: No crop suits this location under the current conditions. Try with irrigation available.

outlook.title: Forecast outlook
outlook.subtitle: Forecast of temperature, humidity, soil moisture and rainfall for one and three months, with three ranked crops for each period.
outlook.demoBody: This is the default date. The forecast uses the readings available up to {{date}}; it is not a live forecast of current weather.
outlook.methodBaseline: Estimate from climate and recent readings
outlook.grid: The nearest data point is {{km}} km from your location.
outlook.cropsBody: Ranked by how well each crop fits the forecast above.
outlook.noneBody: No crop is recommended for this period under the forecast. The ranking below is for comparison only.
outlook.unavailable: The forecast is not available right now
outlook.unavailableBody: The forecast package is not installed on the server.
outlook.historyBody: The forecast uses the readings available up to {{date}} (the day before the planting start date); it is not a live forecast of current weather.
outlook.dateHint: Change the date to see the one- and three-month forecast that starts from it.
outlook.dateRange: Data is available for dates between {{a}} and {{b}}.
outlook.dateFixed: Only the default date is available right now.
outlook.cropsBodyMulti: Ranked across the factors: expected climate, water, soil, fertility and crop rotation.

hist.title: Historically observed indicators
hist.body: These are readings of the same period in earlier years, not a forecast. No forecasting model exists for them.
hist.note: Mean of {{a}}–{{b}} for the same period of the year.

soilInfo.title: Soil information
soilInfo.none: The source has no soil data for this location (usually a built-up area).
soilInfo.failed: Soil information could not be loaded right now.
soilInfo.source: Source: ISRIC SoilGrids, mean of {{a}}–{{b}} cm depth at the nearest data point.
soilInfo.static: Static properties of the location, fetched automatically; not a forecast.

planner.title: Crop Rotation Planner
planner.subtitle: A preliminary sequential planting plan for ninety days, built on the team's forecasts and recommendation system.
planner.forecastBody: Temperature, humidity and soil moisture are phase averages; rainfall is the phase total.
planner.derivedNote: Second-phase values are derived arithmetically from the 30- and 90-day forecasts; they are not an independent forecast.
planner.derivedBad: The 30- and 90-day forecasts are inconsistent for this location and date, so second-phase values are not relied on.
planner.weightsNote: Rotation score = 40% first crop suitability + 40% second crop suitability + 15% family diversity + 5% duration compatibility. Heuristic weights, not scientifically validated values.
planner.partial: Partial plan: a first crop only

plans.title: Saved plans
plans.subtitle: Crop rotation plans you saved for this farm.
plans.emptyBody: Create a plan in the Rotation Planner, then press "Save plan".
plans.deleteBody: This plan will be permanently deleted.

history.title: Agricultural history of the land
history.body: What was grown on this land before? It feeds the crop rotation compatibility.
history.yearHint: Leave empty if it was the last season.
history.greenhouseNote: In a greenhouse the forecast temperature, humidity and rainfall are left out of the score because they are outdoor values, irrigation becomes a requirement, and recommendations stay conditional.

lab.title: Laboratory soil test results
lab.body: If you have a laboratory test of your soil, enter what you know from it. A value you enter replaces the automatic estimate in the calculation; anything left empty stays on the estimate.

error.range: A value is out of range: pH from 0 to 14, percentages from 0 to 100, other values not negative.
error.texture: Enter sand, silt and clay together, or leave all three empty.

score.coverage: {{pct}}% of the factors were evaluated. The rest have no data and were not counted.
score.note: Scores are rule-based suitability indicators, not probabilities of crop success.
